event.name: Heartland Association of Fairs, Festivals and Events Convention

profile.description: HAFFE industry convention. The Adventure Zone attended in 2025 and used it for fair/festival lead generation. The 2026 convention is Nov. 19-21 at The Clarion in Minot, ND.

notes.subject: 2026 convention active - showcase deadline Sept. 1
notes.body: HAFFE emailed Adventure Zone June 27, 2026 inviting applications to showcase at its November convention with a Sept. 1 deadline. Current official HAFFE information confirms the 2026 convention is Nov. 19-21, 2026 at The Clarion in Minot, ND, with showcases built into the convention schedule. Adventure Zone has real 2025 HAFFE convention history, so this is an active industry relationship, not a cold lead.

followUps.label: Review HAFFE showcase application before Sept. 1
followUps.reason: The 2026 HAFFE showcase invitation has a Sept. 1 deadline and the convention remains active Nov. 19-21 in Minot.
